load_hg_token_model: load a Hugging Face tokenizer model from a path with optional token overrides
create_HuggingFaceTokenEncoder: create a HuggingFaceTokenEncoder with prefix and suffix tokens for encoding text to tensors
create_HuggingFaceTokenDecoder: create a HuggingFaceTokenDecoder to decode token index tensors back to text strings
encode_text_with_HuggingFaceTokenEncoder: encode text to a PyTorch tensor using HuggingFaceTokenEncoder with custom prefix and suffix tokens
decode_tokens_with_HuggingFaceTokenDecod: decode a tensor of token indices to text using HuggingFaceTokenDecoder with skip special tokens
